notes.title: Achivements Added!
notes.content: Hello all We have tweaked the game a bit and added 9 achievements! Hunt them all down!

notes.title: Graphics Update!
notes.content:
After Some Feedback we have decided to change the graphics up a bit!

There is now more contrast and will now allow for a more enjoyable experience!

Thank you everyone for playing!

notes.title: Qol Changes
notes.content:
After some feedback we have made some changes

Increased visibility in some levels

Added additional text to help players navigate in some levels.

 Thank you guys for playing!

notes.title: Whispers In Paradise Launch
notes.content:
"Whispers in Paradise" is a spine-tingling supernatural adventure that will immerse you in a world where the boundary between reality and the supernatural blurs. Follow the intertwining fates of Emily and Sydney as they navigate a chilling odyssey filled with dark secrets, perilous challenges, and a powerful demon lurking in the shadows.
